rules.name: unusual_privileged_access
rules.description: Privilege changes accompanied by unusual authentication or source-relationship evidence.

rules.name: cross_zone_movement
rules.description: Zone crossings accompanied by remote-administration or new-peer evidence.

rules.name: recovery_impairment
rules.description: Observable backup/recovery conditions based on failure streak, backup age or restore-test age.

rules.name: protected_boundary_adjacency
rules.description: Observable protected-boundary hops or critical-service exposure.

rules.name: service_loss
rules.description: Observable service evidence with incomplete service availability.

rules.name: maintenance_authorization_contradiction
rules.description: Approved-maintenance evidence co-occurring with unusual privilege, relationship, zone or boundary evidence.

safety_boundary: Rules emit evidence only and do not produce the final decision.
No containment, account disabling, network change, OT write or recovery action is executed.
